rows.name: workspace:create-transfer
rows.reason: 受密码保护传输副本实际写入、重读、完整原件/状态/catalog保留；不覆盖旧文件
rows.implementation_scope: Declared authenticated cloud workflow only; native OS filePath/keychain/sender semantics are explicit non-equivalence
rows.boundary: 原生路径/OSkeychain/窗口sender不是云端合同；filePath/fileExists明确null/cloud-project；竞品R0

sourceNodes.observedBehavior: source path required, native save/open dialogs may cancel; create rejects overwriting original; receive requires password and returns transient compatible reader through sw. No absolute host paths are accepted by cloud adapter.

local protected snapshot is opened before copy; fresh DEK/random generated transfer password and SCRYPT AESGCM wrapped slot; secure transfer readback before returning; receive requires exactly one transfer slot, validates field encodings/KDF/AAD/tag and reports password invalid; opened transfer version dispatches full Tx/Yb reader; raw secrets wiped finally.

cf chunks AES256GCM with object identity/chunk AAD, header auth, 4MiB frame, unique temp, fsync, first/last readback then rename; lf authenticates header and each requested chunk, bounds range, zeroes key close; df checks objectType/objectId, single local slot, unwraps read or protectedWrite then closes/wipes.

safeStorage availability required; encrypted device recovery DRK, password SCRYPT CMK slot, AAD slot metadata; unlocked-session TTL and wiping, exact slot/keyId checks; protected-write can use device slot without exposing material key; atomic mode0600 metadata write. Native OS domain is not reproduced by cloud tenant DATA_KEY and cannot be declared native-equivalent.

rows.source_evidence_policy: Finite named preload/handler/service/key/codec/fs/receipt graph; does not establish whole renderer/native runtime.
